24.original: Use the Daemir Demolishers on the mudstone mound in the Shroud of the Samgha.

25.original: Obtain the hunk of Ksiroda mudstone.

26.original: Deliver the hunk of Ksiroda mudstone to Maru.

48.original: I've been meanin' to ask you this for some time, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but truth be told, I was nervous. Thought it might be too dangerous...

49.original: But then Kancana told me that your adventures've tossed you into the maw of death an' back again. I figure handlin' some explosives is child's play compared to that...right?

50.original: ...Well, you're still here, so I'll take that as a sign of tacit agreement. We need someone to break up the mudstone around Ksiroda an' bring back a piece. The alchemists keep tellin' me this is the best way, but...just mind your fingers, alright?

51.original: There you are─an' with fingers an' toes still attached! I take it that means the alchemists were right after all.

52.original: Good, good─these'll do it. Mixin' mudstone into water makes a paste that keeps the skin safer from sun an' wind than just about anythin'.

53.original: You might not think it to look at 'em, but hippos have a delicate hide. If you don't keep it nice and moist, it'll crack like so much mud on a hot day. We're really in your debt this time.

54.original: Sure, maybe you could've just broken up the stone with a hammer an' chisel...but now I don't gotta worry about someone accidentally settin' those demolishers alight an' blowin' us all into the next life, neither.
